intro: A Little Beauty is a local task in the Shen'dar Highlands where travelers gather soft hippogryph down feathers near Zephras. The colorful plumes are used by the Skyborne to adorn their hair, bringing a touch of simple joy and beauty to the village during challenging times.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: The hippogryphs that have taken up residence southwest of the village can be a nuisance, but they also present a rather unique opportunity to obtain their feathers. Many skyborne love to adorn their hair with vibrant plumes and the down feathers of a hippogryph are exceptionally vibrant and, more importantly, silky soft.
If you are heading that way, try and gather as many of the fallen feathers as you can from around their nesting grounds. Do be careful, as wild hippogryph are not tolerant of guests.

clips.title: Progress
paras: What beautiful things did you bring me?

clips.title: Completion
paras: It might seem a bit of a vain triviality, gathering feathers for our hair. However, even in times like these, one needs to embrace the small joys as much as possible.
If one thing I create brings someone joy, then I will consider that to be a good day. Thank you for bringing me these and helping me bring some joy to Zephras.
